plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to zero.

conservative.read: This plan prioritizes capital preservation with a target of ~1.5% monthly growth. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration risk, aiming for lower drawdowns.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to minimal levels.

Buy SPXS at 6% to add a hedging element.
